def state():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sq = {}
    for r in range(8, 50):
        for c in range(38, 48):
            if a[r][c] in 'RbN':
                sq.setdefault(a[r][c], []).append(r)
    mrows = [r for r in range(64) if 'M' in a[r][10:17]]
    cable = {}
    for r in range(28, 44):
        cells = [c for c in range(16, 48) if a[r][c] in 'wg']
        if cells: cable[r] = (min(cells), max(cells))
    return (mrows[0], mrows[-1]) if mrows else None, cable, {k:(min(v),max(v)) for k,v in sq.items()}

# Probe 1: cable at min, then UP
for _ in range(5): action(['LEFT'])
print('cable min', state())
action(['UP']); print('UP@min', state())
# Probe 2: cable at max, then UP
for _ in range(5): action(['RIGHT'])
print('cable max', state())
action(['UP']); print('UP@max', state())
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','score','level_completed','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
